children: Blue Owl Capital closed a $398 million term debt securitization through Owl Rock CLO XXVI, issuing AAA to A notes and borrowing $25 million under Class A-L loans, all secured by middle market loans and scheduled to mature in July 2038. The company also purchased $106.15 million of preferred shares issued by the CLO, serving as risk retention. An affiliate, Blue Owl Credit Advisors, will manage the collateral and may reinvest loan proceeds through July 2030. Initial collateral of about $362.067 million in loans was sold to the CLO at par.
